audit_metadata.title: Audit 2: Comprehensive Security & Architectural Verification Audit
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer & Enterprise Security Architect
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Phase 2: Deterministic Verification Engine, PostgreSQL Persistence Tier & Rate Limiting

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: Zero offshore AI dispatches; deterministic verification executes 100% locally; UAE sovereign compute and local storage preserved

fr_2_2_exact_domain_allowlist.verification: Exact registrable domain matching using tldextract; prevents sub-domain spoofing and wildcards

fr_2_3_idn_homograph_arabic_protection.verification: IDN Punycode decoding; strict Arabic Unicode regex on .امارات ccTLD; length-normalized Levenshtein lookalike detection

fr_3_1_tri_state_verdict_synthesis.verification: Deterministic tri-state verdict synthesis (RED/AMBER/GREEN) with official Dubai Police e-Crime and 901 hotline escalation

fr_3_3_webhook_latency_sla.verification: FastAPI webhook decouples incoming payload to Celery asynchronously via apply_async in <30ms, satisfying <500ms Meta SLA

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_b_segregation.verification: Citizen phone pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; raw phone purged from worker memory frame; Class A IoCs stored in plain text

fr_4_2_pii_sanitization.verification: Bilingual regex scrubber redacts Emirates IDs, credit cards, and OTP codes before evaluation or persistence

nfr_1_3_rate_limiting.verification: Redis atomic token-bucket limiter enforcing 5 queries/hr per citizen user hash with graceful fallback

sql_injection_immunity.verification: SQLAlchemy 2.0 typed ORM queries across all repositories; zero raw SQL strings or f-string queries

tri_network_isolation.verification: docker-compose isolates DB and Redis exclusively on internal: true bridge without default gateway

non_root_execution.verification: Dockerfile runner stage enforces USER hares:hares (UID 10001)

AUDIT-OBS-01.action: Implemented try/except Exception in webhook POST returning HTTP 400 Bad Request; verified by test_webhook_post_malformed_json_returns_400

AUDIT-OBS-02.action: Broker error logging and isolation in place; production circuit-breaker scheduled for Phase 4 deployment

AUDIT-OBS-03.action: Implemented RedisTokenBucketRateLimiter and wired into Celery tasks; verified by test_rate_limiter suite

AUDIT-OBS-04.action: Implemented allowlist.py, homograph.py, sanitizer.py, and verdict.py in src/hares/engine/; verified by test_engine suite

AUDIT-OBS-05.action: Implemented SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM models and repositories in src/hares/db/ using backend-agnostic Uuid; verified by test_db suite

observations_and_findings.title: Input Text Length Bounding Prior to Regex Scanning
observations_and_findings.description: Entity extraction and PII scrubbing execute regexes across incoming text bodies. While WhatsApp messages are bounded to 4096 characters by Meta, internal invocations with oversized text (>50k chars) can consume CPU cycles.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Enforce a strict text slice limit (raw_text[:4096]) upon entering EntityExtractor.extract and PIIScrubber.scrub.

observations_and_findings.title: Redis Rate Limiter Multi-Command Atomicity via Lua Script
observations_and_findings.description: check_and_increment executes self._redis.incr(key) followed by self._redis.expire(key, ...) on the first request. A crash between incr and expire could leave an orphan key without TTL.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Bundle the increment and expiration into an atomic Redis Lua script (eval) to ensure zero orphan keys on abrupt process termination.

observations_and_findings.title: Guaranteed In-Memory Purge via try...finally Scope
observations_and_findings.description: del recipient_phone and del raw_sender_phone are executed at loop completion. An unhandled exception during processing could leave the variable reference in the traceback frame.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Enclose processing loop in try...finally where finally guarantees execution of del recipient_phone.

observations_and_findings.title: Explicit Air-Gapped Flag for tldextract
observations_and_findings.description: tldextract.TLDExtract defaults to bundled offline public suffixes when network fails. On hares_internal bridge, passing suffix_list_urls=None explicitly prevents socket probe attempts.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Initialize TLDExtract with suffix_list_urls=None to declare air-gapped operation deterministically.
